title: Maximum Width Ramp
description: A ramp is a pair of indices `i < j` with `nums[i] <= nums[j]`; its width is `j - i`. Given `nums`, return the maximum ramp width, or 0 if no positive-width ramp exists.
hints: Maintain the prefix or window information needed to count candidate ranges.
Check repeated values, extreme bounds, and cases with no valid segment.
